profile.org_note: Single-entity, family-owned builder run from one home office in College Station; no division presidents are published, and the CEO told HousingWire (2026-10-27) that divisional leadership is the next organisational step under consideration. Land (acquisition, entitlement, design, development) sits with one executive, VP of Development & Acquisition Stephen Grove; finance sits with CFO Jason Williams; both are presumed to report to owner/CEO Doug French. Legal name per Texas TDLR record and BBB profile (incorporated 1987).
profile.summary: Private, second-generation family-owned entry-level builder (attached and detached, roughly low $200Ks to high $400Ks) in secondary Texas markets: Bryan/College Station, Waco, Temple/Killeen, Georgetown/Jarrell, Seguin, Huntsville/Conroe and Tyler. It deliberately avoids the big metros (exited Houston around 2023-2024) and is exiting one more underperforming market in 2026. HousingWire reports 973 sales for about $310M in 2025 (Builder 100: 1,068 closings) and guidance of 1,100-1,200 sales in 2026; a build-for-rent arm (South Six Construction Group) is under 10% of deliveries. Conventional for-sale builder that entitles and develops its own lots, so a plausible but small land-banking customer.

people.name: Stephen Grove
people.title: Vice President of Development & Acquisition
people.note: The single land head: company bio says he oversees all of Stylecraft's land assets, covering acquisition, entitlement, design and development, and works with internal and external parties to keep land inventory available. Covers both land acquisition and land development. Reporting line to the CEO is inferred from title (could run through the COO).

people.name: Jason Williams
people.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
people.prior_role: About 20 years in financial services and real estate (VP and Controller roles in banking, construction, title/insurance, mortgage, residential brokerage); employers not named
people.note: Leads finance: accounting, FP&A, IT and HR. No separate treasurer is published, so he is the finance and lender-relationship contact. Reporting line inferred from title.

people.name: Doug French
people.title: Owner | President & Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
people.note: Second-generation owner; son of founder Randy French. Company page says CEO since 2017; HousingWire (2026-06-11) says he joined in 2009 as VP and became CEO in 2015, and Pro Builder already called him chief executive in June 2015. Also operates Leading Realty Group, which develops and manages single-family rentals in Bryan, Temple and College Station.
